svg.text: Drawn the spring after the sky failed,
from the accounts of people who walked it.
cold that came with the dark, and stayed
old grudges reigniting for no reason at all
where a line stops, so did whoever reported it
Liming Harbor is the last port still chartering
Four to bind, three to heal —
and the binding does not heal.
read from a finger-bone at Twilight Gap,
twelve days' march, in the old light
